title: Abnegate (demo playable in browser)
author: Abnegatethehate
selftext:
My games up with a demo on itch. The game was built as a single html file using Claude. Inspired by Ghost Busters and Luigi's Mansion, you explore a mall and capture different ghosts. Each type has its own capture pattern, as well as unique boss battles. I would not classify it as a Metroidvania, but you do obtain different abilities that allow you to access different gated areas.  
I was hoping to get this out by Halloween, but it took longer than expected. I at least got a playable demo live for now! I'm still working on proper mobile controls, so I don't recommend trying that. It's optimally played with an Xbox controller.

Workflow:  
I dumped all my ideas into ChatGPT to help form a cohesive game design document.  
I told it to give me a list of everything that needs to be decided before building.  
Then I went through everything it listed and locked them all out in one go.  
Once I had the full game design doc entirely finished, I took that over to Claude.  
I told Claude I wanted it to build me a single contained  
HTML file using my GDD.  
I'm using a Claude pro subscription and set it to max for this step.  
After that single session I had a fully playable version.  
It was still far from complete but the concept was there.  
From there I moved to play testing, with some minor and other major changes to fit my vision better.  
Anything that was basic like "increase the amount of enemies in X room", I'd use medium or low effort.  
Any graphical changes I always use Max, I'm not sure if that's ideal, but I always seem to get better results this way.
